method: Static review only: SHA-256 verification, atomscan before/after, cleave facts, full Python source review, and ILSpy decompilation with entry-point/callback/worker tracing. Samples were not executed.

evidence: The wheel contains lbenc.py, package metadata and a console entry point; extracted source is byte-identical to the archived source.
handle_document downloads the submitted Telegram document into a per-user temporary directory. handle_callback selects a named transformer and sends the resulting file to that conversation.

Transformers encode, compress, XOR or marshal supplied Python source into wrapper source. compile() creates a code object for marshal.dumps(); ast.parse() validates generated text. No exec/eval call executes the uploaded source in the bot.
Non-Python uploads are zipped unchanged. /cancel deletes the per-user temporary directory. The bot token is supplied through BOT_TOKEN.
The package description describes older configuration options and 30 transformations, while source implements 19. This discrepancy does not establish hostile behavior.
samples.context: Operator intent and a live deployment were not supplied. The reviewed bytes perform the advertised file-processing purpose; no covert collection, hidden execution or attacker-controlled endpoint was found.

samples.identification: NanoCoreFinal-branded custom RAT; namespace is not a verified NanoCore family attribution
evidence: Main claims Microsoft Windows Update identity, copies itself, writes startup and Run-key launchers, registers an on-logon task and attempts fodhelper DelegateExecute elevation.
Main starts KeyloggerModule. HookCallback records keyboard events and active-window titles; SendLoop appends a local keylog and passes a Base64 KEYLOG record to SendToC2.
Clipboard, screenshots, Chromium stores and selected document/credential extensions feed SendToC2 or SendFile. SendFile reads bytes and constructs a Base64 FILE record.
StartCommandExecutor reads an HTTP response, passes commands to cmd.exe /c and sends output back. StartReverseShell bridges an outbound TCP stream to cmd stdin/stdout.

SendToC2 applies a repeating XOR key and Base64 to its records and constructs an HTTP GET query. Config.C2_DOMAIN already includes http://, so the added scheme and TcpClient hostname are malformed; working command/exfiltration transport is not established.

The webcam worker sends 1061, not ANSI SaveDIB 1049. No successful frame-save or camera exfiltration is claimed. Its microphone helper is also unreliable. The injected six-byte stub merely computes and returns a value, rather than hollowing a process.
Defender-disabling commands, an added administrator account and an NtSetInformationProcess class-29 enable-call attempt reinforce the attack assessment; permissions and success are unproven.
samples.context: No installation authorization or operator context was supplied. Deceptive Windows Update branding and automatic spying, persistence and remote-command setup outweigh the possibility of legitimate remote administration.

samples.identification: NanoCoreUltimate-branded destructive stealer with ransom behavior; family attribution unverified
evidence: Main immediately starts mouse interference and blocks input, then invokes security-service stops, Defender disabling, hosts-file poisoning, shadow-copy deletion, an IFEO tool hijack, elevation attempts and self replication.

Hook and polling keyloggers, clipboard monitoring, screenshot capture, document-prefix collection and cookie reads pass records to SendToC2. That function logs locally and calls WebClient.UploadString on the configured external HTTP URL.
IsPlaceholder() disables the rotating-subdomain beacon, but does not gate the direct SendToC2 upload path.

AccessWindowsCredentialManager combines LocalApplicationData with Microsoft/Credentials, enumerates files and copies them into the collection directory. Encrypted credential blobs are copied; no decrypted credentials are established.
USBWorm copies the executable to removable drives, marks it hidden and writes autorun.inf. Run/RunOnce, startup copies and scheduled tasks provide persistence attempts.

RealEncryption targets only Desktop/TestFolder. Its AES key is 16 bytes and its IV is 15 bytes, so setting the IV throws before encrypted output and original deletion. Retained detection explicitly describes an attempted file replacement.

Independent destructive paths still delete recovery data, disable SafeBoot/System Restore, kill process tools and disable the firewall. Ransom notes and wallpaper, input interference, fake-decryptor self copies and eventual shutdown are also wired from Main.

Some helpers are uncalled, several operations need privileges, and unhandled I/O failures can stop later initialization. Simulation labels and broken helpers do not neutralize the unrestricted destructive and surveillance paths.
samples.context: Deployment provenance and operator authorization are missing. No safety mode gates the external upload or recovery-disabling paths; these concrete actions tip the verdict despite simulation wording.

trait_changes: Remove import-only marshal serialization duplicate and use the canonical engine import in its consumer.
Move column-zero marshal import syntax into source declaration metadata and preserve its consumer reference.
Move archive identifier vocabulary into source naming metadata and stop using it as proof of an archive staging path.
Move an unqualified connect call from name vocabulary to source call syntax; preserve its WebSocket consumer.
Tighten Windows Update task namespace recognition so registry paths do not match.
Remove the WinDefend service name from process-name recognition; the existing Defender service reference remains.
Add CLR Microsoft/Credentials component recognition and a keylogger credential-directory copy-reference objective.
Retain accurate existing hostile/suspicious findings; no package-name exceptions or weakened encryption-success claims.
reference_use: Windows SDK defines WM_CAP_FILE_SAVEDIBA as WM_USER + 25; sample-specific WM_CAP_SAVEDIB naming was not accepted as proof of frame capture.
